title: The swarm lab's Pearl lane drives, fires and bumps as the game does: the boss lab's game drive and cannon, the game's shell blast, and the game's hull contact moved into src/fx/hull-contact.js and shared (owner, 2026-10-14, round three)
context: Owner, 2026-10-14, round three of the swarm lab's Pearl mode, verbatim: "the feel of the tank, speed, etc. should be the same as the game, tank shell should be operational. and the bump impact with the creatures should be the same as the game." The coordinator's principle: share the game's code, never re-type it. Before it the lane drove on the yard model (stepYardDrive: 11 m/s, a 265 m radius), had no gun, and a body within the dot lane's touch ratio of the hull died a plain death (2026-10-14-swarm-lab-pearl-drive-death-fps). The boss lab already drives with the game's feel (332ba8a6) and fires the game's shell (1401e48a); the shell's blast is the 2026-10-13 tank-shell blast (8bf59188); the hull against the Pearl bodies lived inside src/fx/creature-enemies.js, which the refactor review of 2026-10-14 (finding 2) said wants src/fx/hull-contact.js.
outcome: Four commits. (1) The feel: the lane drives with src/labs/boss/drive.js createPlaneDrive (the game's steering ease, run-up and pace, hull-drive.js's drive values), the cruise double tap, tankfeel.js's hover and bank, and the game's camera rig src/labs/boss/game-cam.js (tankViewPose, the smoothed heading, the per-frame lerp; its rear inset not shown); boss/drive.js gained an opt-in `slide` (the lane's walls as the game's friction, TANK_WALL: the into-wall share out, the run-up scrubbed by it, the heading turned along) and step()'s { pace, contact } hooks, the boss lab unchanged (--boss passes). Measured cruise in the lane, held W from rest: 37.7 m/s at four seconds (node, 1/60 s steps; the boss-fight spec's 38), 43.4 at nine, 333 m down the lane (no 265 m limit); headless in the browser 35.2 m/s after 2.9 s of wall clock. (2) The shell: Space fires src/labs/boss/cannon.js (the game's shell, pace, reach, three-second barrel, recoil), the game's hit rule (a record within cellSide x max(0.45, size x 0.8), td-tab updateProjectiles) and the game's landing, src/fx/shell-blast.js createShellBlast on the lane's records (SHELL_BLAST 4.5 over 3 cells, the 40 mm's burst and flash), the damage damageEnemy's in short (hit points off, the body shrunk 0.7 + 0.3 x the share left, the game's death at none); one shell into 300 white bodies killed 30-36 headless. Not carried: the blast's impact scare and its warning rings (they need the board's cells), the barrel's heat sleeve colour. (3) The extraction, behaviour-neutral: src/fx/hull-contact.js createHullContact({ tune, mesh, heading, metres, hull, ground, now, brush, hit }) holds hullAt, the deduplicated pushes, the again gate, the drag and scrub, the cored stop and the settle pass, nothing allocated a frame; creature-enemies calls it on the unit sphere through the bodies' seam (ground: onUnitSphere) with the record's reactions (a light tier's brush is the ram; a booked contact counted, a cored one recoiled and jolted), its test harness's hull() reading the module's drag and push. test/hull-body-contact.mjs (the existing test/hull-contact.mjs covers src/domain/hull-contact.js, the rock's faces); node test/pearl-enemies.mjs, test/pearl-impact.mjs and the --pearl-story browser step pass (the amoeba shoved and rammed, a drifter stopping the hull 28.3 -> 0.9 m/s). (4) The bump in the lane: the same module on the lane's plane through the family's hullContact (createLaneHull), the game's ram (a record within cellSide x max(0.4, size x 0.8) of the hull or a light tier brushed: the stagger along the heading and aside, the tinted splat under the treads, the jolt src/fx/ram-jolt.js, the run-over drag td-tab's bumpLeft x 0.65 unless a light tier) and a cored body's touch (every 1.2 s: the recoil and the hard jolt); the touch-radius death of round two retired. Headless: a white body 30 m ahead run over (1 ram, dying); a brown one stopped the hull (drag 0.53-0.59, the hull pushed back 0.4-2.6 m, never rammed). The combo, bounty and hull damage are not the lane's; the camera's bump and jolt dip (the game rig's `dip`) is not applied. npm test 253, npm run check, npm run architecture, node test/swarm-lab-pearl.mjs, --swarm-pearl, --pearl-story and --boss green.
alternatives: Re-typing the drive's ramp and the shell's flight in the lab: the owner's principle is the game's code; the boss lab's modules are the game's composed on a plane, so the lane uses them and the boss lab's drive takes two opt-in hooks.

Driving the lane through src/fx/creature-bodies.js (the game's seam) to share bodyContact without a second caller: the seam is the sphere's hubs and the board's cells; the contact block itself is the shared part, so it moved into its own module with the space (the ground) and the record's reactions as arguments.

Keeping the dot lane's touch radius as the lane's death: the game's ram rule is the record's distance to the hull or a light tier's brush, and cored bodies are never run over; the game's rule replaces it.
